newsitem.title: CHINA: Caterpillar in China castings venture.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar in China castings venture.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc and investment firm ASIMCO have joined major Chinese conglomerate China International Trust and Investment Corp to set up an engine castings plant in north China, ASIMCO said on Thursday.
The plant in Shanxi province will produce castings for medium and heavy-duty diesel engines, said ASIMCO (Asian Strategic Investments Corp).
ASIMCO did not give the value of the joint venture or say how much of a stake each of the parties held.
It said Caterpillar would provide casting technology while ASIMCO and China International Trust would supply capital, facilities, machinery and personnel.
The venture would use China International Trust's existing foundry in Shanxi, an area with large supplies of coal and pig iron needed for the project.

ASIMCO is a Beijing-based but U.S.-managed direct investment company which has 16 joint ventures in China, many of them in the automotive sector. China International Trust has interests in manufacturing, telecommunications and finance and has a substantial stake in Hong Kong-listed CITIC Pacific Ltd .
